statement: 将 Pattern 的稳定 ID、双语名称、别名、Intent、Use When、Anatomy、Realization 与 Validation 编入机器可读索引；自然语言请求先由确定性词汇/字符相似度解析到候选 Pattern，再由代理根据上下文选择，而不是靠记忆猜测 Pattern 名称。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.UIGS.DETERMINISTIC_PATTERN_RETRIEVAL; support threshold intentionally exceeds current independent evidence by one group.

review.rationale: Evidence-insufficient Experimental record modeled without promotion; additional independent evidence is required by policy.
